name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source platform for marketing, sales, operations and customer support, with the Frontline, Sales and Operation plugins, MongoDB and Redis.

alerts.message: Open the app right after deployment: a fresh install redirects to /create-owner, and the first account created there becomes the owner.

Uploads fail until a storage provider is chosen under Settings > File upload. Pick Local to keep files on the uploads volume, or connect your own S3-compatible, Google Cloud, Cloudflare or Azure bucket.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
